profile_text.body:
GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, trading under the ticker GEHC and registered with CIK 0001932393. Its website describes the company as providing digital infrastructure, data analytics and decision support tools that help in the diagnosis, treatment and monitoring of patients.

The company describes itself as building integrated solutions aimed at the healthcare industry's challenges, and says it believes the future of healthcare is precise, personal and connected. It states that it has over 130 years of delivering innovative solutions and that it tops the FDA's list of AI-enabled medical devices.

Its recorded law exposure is in Illinois, with 374 entries. No litigation cases are listed.
